label: Auto-hide the Dock
description: Dock slides away until you move the pointer to the screen edge, freeing screen space.

label: Hide recent apps in the Dock
description: Stops the Dock from adding a 'recent applications' section.

label: Show all file extensions
description: Finder shows .pdf, .zip etc. so you always know the file type.

label: Show hidden files in Finder
description: Dotfiles like .zshrc become visible (toggle anytime with Cmd+Shift+.).

label: Show Finder path & status bars
description: Shows the full folder path and item count at the bottom of Finder windows.

label: Fast key repeat
description: Held keys repeat sooner and faster. Takes effect after logging out and back in.

label: Save screenshots to ~/Pictures/Screenshots
description: Keeps the Desktop clean by saving screenshots to their own folder.

label: Tap to click on the trackpad
description: A light tap counts as a click, no need to press down.
